assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring via CPT 93271 is indicated
The service is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias responsible for the patient's symptoms and to inform stroke prevention decisions
